tasks.short: Examine materials microscopically for contaminant presence and concentration.

steps.what: Verify actual sample identity and prepare material and microscope under the approved contaminant method
Examine actual microscope fields, identify contaminants and record actual observations and counts
Calculate method-defined contaminant concentration from the actual counts and verified preparation factors and check units and validity
Complete and check the actual analysis record v1 including contaminant identification, concentration, method limits and exceptions
Save the exact checked actual analysis record v1 in the same laboratory record

tasks.design: Configure a validated native laboratory calculation in {OTHER}, or the existing controlled {SPREADSHEET}, for the approved method's arithmetic. The technician still prepares and examines the actual material, records actual counts and factors, checks the calculation and authors the actual analysis record before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method arithmetic and unit conversion may be repeated manually after microscopy.
tasks.enabler_now: A controlled native formula can repeat prescribed arithmetic without interpreting images.
tasks.still_hard: Contaminant identification, representative fields and analytical validity remain skilled microscopy.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a real contaminant from an artefact and recognise invalid analysis.

ambition.what: No autonomous contaminant identification or result-release authority.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less arithmetic; the laboratory examination remains central.

reach.role: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
reach.learn: Explain method limits and actual observation provenance.

evidence.claim: Controlled formulas can calculate concentration from actual entered counts and factors; microscopy identification remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's microscopy and analysis record, not a certified external report or a release decision. {OTHER} is the laboratory information and microscopy record environment. Shares are provisional, not measured.

The technician produces actual sample id, observed fields, counts, preparation volume/dilution or other method-specific factors, instrument and method version. Actual capture and checks retain full effort in s1/s2. The method owner supplies formula, units, validity limits and rounding. Missing counts or factors require manual analysis, never plan-derived values.
Test native controlled calculations first and validate against known examples. If calculation is already automatic there is no labour saving. Same-system save and substantive result record stay full.
unknowns: Applicable method and actual manual arithmetic time
Whether native validated calculations already exist
research_questions: Can the existing controlled calculator remove repeated arithmetic while preserving all invalid-result flags?

already_counted.description: Calculation source, unit and validity checks.
Actual analysis record and final substantive check.

incremental.description: Revalidate controlled formula configuration when the approved method changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual analysis record v1; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only a method with manual arithmetic removes 4 of the provisional 10 calculation hours less 0.5 upkeep. An already calculated result gives no gross gain; sample preparation, microscope judgement, actual counts and final record remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Distribute permits, closure plans or cleanup plans.

steps.what: Identify the exact authorised permit, closure or cleanup plan version and its required recipients and distribution restrictions
Assemble the permit or plan package, exact attachments and covering message for the named recipients
Check the complete distribution package v1, recipient list, exact document versions and allowed disclosure before release
Send the exact approved distribution package v1 to its named external recipients
Record and check actual distribution date, document version, recipients and failed deliveries in distribution record v1
Save the exact checked actual distribution record v1 in the same project record

tasks.design: Configure a native {EMAIL} distribution template linked to approved document versions in {DOCS}; populate only the technician's checked instruction and recipient list. The technician checks the complete package, performs its separate send and records actual send results afterwards in {PROJECT}; this does not issue a permit or certify delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated attachment selection and covering-message setup can cause version errors.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mail templates and document links can reduce package assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Correct recipients, disclosure restrictions and failed delivery handling still require a person.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that an authorised plan is for the wrong site or recipient.

ambition.what: No new permit or publication authority.

tasks.altitude: Less package setup with the same release responsibility.

reach.role: Environmental Scientists and Specialists, Including Health
reach.learn: Obtain an exact version and distribution instruction before preparing a package.

evidence.claim: Native mail and document templates can reduce assembly of an authorised distribution package.

assumptions: Boundary is distributing already authorised permits or plans, including actual delivery records. Content authorisation, statutory filing and recipient reading are outside and receive no saving credit. Shares are provisional; no physical postage baseline is assumed.

The document owner produces document id, exact version, site, authorisation and distribution restrictions. The owner or case coordinator maintains required recipients and contact details; the focal technician checks and manually completes missing instructions in s1. The email service produces actual send/failure timestamps; the technician enters and checks these in s5. A send is not proof of receipt.

Test native mail/document configuration first. Package assembly can shrink, but recipient judgement, release review, actual send, result recording and same-system save stay full. Separate internal and external sends if a local distribution uses both.
unknowns: Native document-link support and actual assembly effort
research_questions: Can a native template reduce repeated package setup while preserving exact authorised versions?

already_counted.description: Final disclosure, recipient and exact-version approval.

incremental.description: Maintain package templates and approved document-link rules.

approvals.approved_version: approved distribution package v1 including exact documents, message and named external recipients; changes void approval
checked actual distribution record v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A recurring electronic distribution can remove 12 of 30 package-setup hours per provisional 100 task hours less 1 upkeep. One-off plans have less repeated setup; send, authorisation checks and actual delivery recording retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Controlled calculations and document templates reduce a small amount of repeated work while observation and release checks remain human.
reach: Give environmental scientists traceable analysis and distribution records.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish actual observations and send results from expectations
role.ambitious_version: A technician with reliable controlled records and unchanged scientific or permit authority.

job.title: Environmental Science and Protection Technicians, Including Health
